newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: FORECAST-Portugal Telcom profit seen up.
newsitem.headline: FORECAST-Portugal Telcom profit seen up.

text.p: Portugal Telecom (PT) should have closed the first half with a consolidated net profit of 20-26 billion escudos ($127-$168 million), sharply above last year's 14.7 billion, analysts said on Wednesday.
The forecasts were generally higher than the 20.5 billion escudo profit that the company itself predicted just two months ago. The results will be released from 0800 GMT on Thursday.
Analysts put the improved performance down to earnings from its TMN mobile phone subsidiary, the Telepac networking company and profit on financial operations.

"The improved contribution from TMN, Telepac and financial operations allow us to forecast a consolidated profit for the six months of 22 billion escudos and 49 billion for the whole year," said Jose Freire of Lisbon's Gesfinc.
Analysts' forecasts for the full-year range between 45 and 50 billion escudos.
Paulo Guerreiro of brokers M. Valores said he expected a profit of 26 billion escudos, taking account of lower costs, higher traffic and lower debt.
But Fincor's Ulugbek Suyumov was more cautious, predicting around 20 billion in line with the company's earlier forecast.
Portugal Telecom shares have risen nearly 50 percent since the start of the year to stand at 4,100 escudos.
